description:
Zillow missed the mark on this Killeen home - here's what they got wrong.

I ran a professional home value report and compared it to Zillow's estimate. The difference? $20k! This is exactly why homeowners need accurate valuations before listing.

Want a FREE home value report for your Killeen - Temple area property? Drop your address in the comments or DM me!

Day 4/100 of proving that algorithm estimates can't replace local expertise. Follow along as I compare real valuations to Zillow's guesses across Killeen-Fort Hood.
